_sheet: Network events between the players of one PEAK lobby. One row = one Photon RaiseEvent code the mod sends. Generated/NetEvents.cs gets a struct per row with Write/Read (BinaryWriter/BinaryReader, little endian) built from the fields column.

_columns.code: Photon event code, byte. PEAK uses 1,2,3,4,18; PUN reserves 200+; the mod owns 90-119
_columns.name: struct name
_columns.fields: ordered list of {name, type}; types: byte, bool, int, float, double, string, byte[], int[]
_columns.handler: method in CampfireCards.Net that the dispatcher calls with the decoded struct and the sender actor number

rows.name: Hello
rows.receivers: Others (the host answers the sender with its own Hello, targeted)
rows.purpose: announce the mod version and the settings fingerprint (Core.SettingsFingerprint: global rules, rarity weights x10000, one hash per card) so players with different versions or card settings are told exactly what differs

rows.name: PickSessionStart
rows.purpose: a pick session begins: pick order (actor numbers, last to the fire first; also the dealing order), each player's dealt hand (handSize card ids per player, in order), the host's timer and mode (Core.PickMode: 0 everyone chooses at once, 1 one at a time). reason: 0 opening, 1 campfire; segment: the campfire segment (255 = opening), so every client knows which session started and a new host can continue the queue; timeoutSeconds = 0 means unlimited time; ghosts are excluded from the order

rows.name: PickMade
rows.purpose: the host accepted a pick (a player's PickRequest, or its own timeout pick): everyone checks it against the session (id, player, hand, not picked yet) and adds the card

rows.name: StateSync
rows.purpose: full card state for a late joiner or reconnecting player (counts[i] cards for actors[i], flattened in cards; pickFlags[i] = bit 1 skip next pick, bit 2 next offer is reduced (Double Down); penaltyCounts[i] Clown Luggage penalties for actors[i], flattened in penaltyVariants)

rows.name: Arrival
rows.purpose: this player first came within the campfire's rest radius: time is PhotonNetwork.Time so the host can order picks last-arrival-first

rows.name: StateRequest
rows.sender: a player who has no state yet
rows.purpose: ask the host for StateSync

rows.name: CardsGranted
rows.purpose: bonus cards for a player (Double Deal / Double Down); everyone adds them to that player's collection; reason 9 = the host F8 restore, added without acquisition effects (live:false) and exempt from the repeat check

rows.name: SessionEnd
rows.purpose: all turns done or timed out: close waiting banners

rows.name: CardSacrificed
rows.purpose: Mountain's Bargain: the owner gave up this card; everyone removes it from that player's collection

rows.name: SkipNextPick
rows.purpose: Phoenix Clause fired: this player skips their next campfire pick

rows.name: ReviveRequest
rows.purpose: ask the host to spend an Eternal Campfire owner's per-biome revive on this scout

rows.name: ReviveGranted
rows.purpose: the host approved the revive; the downed scout revives itself

rows.name: InjuryShare
rows.purpose: Shared Burden: the card owner takes this much Injury (never re-shared)

rows.name: BonusStamina
rows.purpose: grant bonus stamina to another scout (Hero's Arrival); the receiver applies it to itself

rows.name: SpawnItem
rows.purpose: ask the host for a card's campfire item (Rope Baron, Supply Scout) for the fire lit for this segment; the host checks the card, the item and that the fire was lit, places it next to that fire itself, and spawns it once per card per fire

rows.name: RevivedBy
rows.purpose: tell the scout who fed you back on your feet that they revived you (Hero's Arrival)

rows.name: PickRequest
rows.purpose: a player asks to take a card from their offer; the host validates it (session, turn, hand, not picked or claimed yet) and answers everyone with PickMade

rows.name: PickSkipped
rows.purpose: the host removes a scout who died before choosing; every client advances the session without granting a card; stale and repeated skips do nothing

rows.name: CardPenalty
rows.purpose: Clown Luggage Special rolls one permanent penalty per acquisition; slot = how many the owner already had, so a replayed message cannot reroll or duplicate it. Included in state sync; sacrificing the card keeps it.

rows.name: CardRewardUsed
rows.purpose: The host spawned the one-time Balloon Bunch; retain the used bit in pickFlags for state sync and host migration.
